verdict.rationale: Ironclad's Records/Workflows APIs and webhooks (docs-2, docs-4, docs-13, docs-30) let an external system read contract data, trigger workflows, and receive event notifications, which could be used to build renewal/deadline monitoring and automated action. However, there is no explicit documentation of renewal-date fields, expiration alerts, or a dedicated deadline-monitoring webhook event—an agent would have to infer/construct this from generic record and workflow data. Missing for 10: explicit renewal/expiration tracking fields or webhook event types, and any first-party example of an agent acting on approaching deadlines.
